company.name: Flock Homes
company.shortDescription: Flock Homes allows individuals to own rental homes through portfolio shares.
company.description: Flock Homes converts individual rental properties into fully-passive, diversified shares in a pool of houses. Flock helps rental property owners retire from being landlords. The company offers low-cost, tax-advantaged, hassle-free way to get and keep all the benefits of owning rental properties without any of the burdens. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables landlords to sell their rental properties by exchanging them for portfolio shares, allowing deferral of capital gains taxes and passive income generation.
productsAndServices.name: Flock Exchange

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $20,000,000, or 36.93% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,907,653 to $156,322,989, a 17.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 63 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-5).
